capabilities: Annotates embedded images with pen, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, text and mosaic tools
Replaces the original image on save or exports a new PNG file
Converts JPG, WebP, BMP and GIF images to PNG and updates all vault links
extras: Non-PNG images are auto-converted to PNG on save, with all vault links to the old file updated automatically.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to annotate, crop or mosaic an image without leaving the app and re-importing the file.
summary: Right-click image editor for Obsidian notes that annotates, crops and mosaics embedded images, replacing the original in place.
